scenarios.pitch: Fruit and vegetable wholesaler: nobody knows how many returnable crates are really sitting at customers — 1,800 according to their own Excel, while the biggest customer says 950.
scenarios.briefing: Scope is the current crate balance per customer per week. Drivers keep working with paper slips, Sven and Nienke type them into Excel. Quarterly reconciliation with customers needs to get easier.

scenarios.pitch: Construction company with six or seven projects running: margin per project is only known once the project is already finished. Rule of thumb: below fifteen percent it starts to get worrying.
scenarios.briefing: Scope is a weekly margin overview per project, ready before the Monday meeting with Erik. Hours come from the site foremen's Excel timesheets, purchase invoices from Exact Online. Threshold: fifteen percent margin.

scenarios.sourceSystem: Excel sheets per sales rep (Exact Online only for invoicing)
scenarios.pitch: Wholesaler with about eight field sales reps: every rep has their own Excel pipeline, merging them costs Marloes four hours every week and is already out of date by Monday.
scenarios.briefing: Scope is an up-to-date pipeline overview per rep and region for the monthly management meeting, without a CRM project. The reps keep using their own Excel sheets.
